claims.statement: The pinned 2019 paper states the r>=3 exclusion as Conjecture 3.4.7, PDF page 19.
The inspected 2026 v1 statements give a general twin-clique update and a complete-bipartite specialization; those statements do not state the all-r minimum-part sign theorem.
The abstract page inspected on 10 September 2026 lists v1 submitted on 4 August 2026 as its only version.
The named conjectural clause supplies a precise nontrivial candidate contribution; current priority requires the separate follow-up investigation and independent review.
